ui.chat.tags.none_yet.note: One line at the narrow sidebar; Manage tags remains the action.

ui.chat.tags.manage_title.note: No ellipsis: this names the open dialog, not its launch action.

ui.chat.tags.apply_deletion_first.note: name is a category deleted and recreated in one draft. Two Apply operations are needed so the backend does not reuse its ID and keep assignments.

ui.chat.tags.moved_to.note: Success toast after a row tag move; name is the destination category. Includes Undo.

ui.chat.tags.removed_all.note: Success toast after clearing every tag and the primary in one write.

ui.chat.tags.remove_all.note: Row-menu action. Count is DISTINCT assigned tags: singular removes one tag; plural removes all assignments.

ui.chat.tags.move_menu.note: Row-menu keyboard/single-pointer alternative to drag; opens the compact move picker.

ui.chat.tags.changed_elsewhere.note: 409 revision conflict; authoritative tags are refreshed, never silently retried.

ui.chat.tags.move_armed.note: Live announcement when a conversation row arms after a hold. Name is the conversation title.

ui.chat.tags.move_cancelled.note: Live announcement after Escape, blur, pointer cancellation, or an ineligible drop. No write.

ui.chat.tags.undo.note: Toast action restoring assignments with the revision returned by the original write.

ui.chat.tags.move_undone.note: Live announcement only after Undo succeeds.

ui.chat.tags.move_title.note: Compact dialog heading; title is the conversation name, not a category.

ui.chat.tags.move_description.note: Compact move dialog: promote a category while preserving other assignments; Untagged clears all.

ui.chat.tags.move_failed.note: Move-specific failure and retry guidance; never substitutes for the revision-conflict message.
